params.owner_: The owner (intended: the governance safe); gates pause/unpause and upgrades.
params.token_: The eXYZ stablecoin this vault shields (must expose `mintTo`/`burnFrom`).

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

proxiableUUID().details: Implementation of the ERC-1822 {proxiableUUID} function. This returns the storage slot used by the implementation. It is used to validate the implementation's compatibility when performing an upgrade. IMPORTANT: A proxy pointing at a proxiable contract should not be considered proxiable itself, because this risks bricking a proxy that upgrades to it, by delegating to itself until out of gas. Thus it is critical that this function revert if invoked through a proxy. This is guaranteed by the `notDelegated` modifier.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

shield(uint128,bytes32,bytes32).details: ALLOWANCE PREREQUISITE: `Stablecoin.burnFrom` spends the caller's ERC-20 allowance      even for BURNER_ROLE holders, so the user MUST `token.approve(address(this), amount)`      before calling.The shield opening is public calldata (no memo): the precompile itself recomputes      `cm = keccak256(DOM_NOTE || token || ownerAddr || amount_be16 || salt)`, so a hidden      amount larger than the burned amount cannot be smuggled in.Burn-then-credit order: if the precompile leg fails, the whole transaction - burn      included - reverts atomically (the precompile halt carries empty returndata; the      revert surfaces as `LowLevelCallFailure` with empty `returnData`).A blacklisted caller cannot shield: the token's `_update` hook reverts the burn.

params.amount: Token amount to shield; must be nonzero (u128 per TN-SHIELD v1).
params.ownerAddr: Shielded address `a = keccak256(DOM_ADDR || pk_spend || pk_view)` that                  owns the new note.
params.salt: Fresh 32-byte note salt chosen by the caller.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

unshield(bytes,bytes).details: COMPLIANCE: a blacklisted `recipient` makes the token's `_update` hook revert      (`Blacklisted(to)`), rolling back the WHOLE transaction - including the precompile's      nullifier marks and tree insertion - so the shielded note stays unspent and remains      spendable toward a compliant recipient.Callable by anyone (relayable): recipient and amount are fixed by the proof's public      values, not by the caller. The precompile independently enforces that this vault is      `vaultOf[token]` for the proof's token.On success the precompile returns exactly `abi.encode(address recipient, uint128      amount)`; malformed returndata makes `abi.decode` revert.

params.proof: TN-SHIELD v1 Plonk proof envelope bytes (opaque to the vault).
params.publicValues: The TN-SHIELD v1 public-values blob (op = unshield; opaque to the vault).

upgradeToAndCall(address,bytes).details: Upgrade the implementation of the proxy to `newImplementation`, and subsequently execute the function call encoded in `data`. Calls {_authorizeUpgrade}. Emits an {Upgraded} event.

PRECOMPILE().notice: Canonical address of the TN-SHIELD shielded-stablecoin precompile; must match         `SHIELDED_PRECOMPILE_ADDRESS` in the Telcoin-Network node. Genesis gives the         address one `0xfe` (INVALID) byte of code so the account is never state-pruned and         any call bypassing precompile dispatch reverts instead of hitting an empty account.

initialize(address,address).notice: Initializes the vault for exactly one token; called once via proxy deployment.

pause().notice: Pauses `shield` and `unshield`. Only the owner (governance safe) may pause.

shield(uint128,bytes32,bytes32).notice: Shields `amount` of the vault's token: burns it from the caller's public balance,         then has the precompile append a note commitment owned by `ownerAddr`.

token().notice: The eXYZ stablecoin this vault shields.

unpause().notice: Unpauses `shield` and `unshield`. Only the owner (governance safe) may unpause.

unshield(bytes,bytes).notice: Unshields tokens: submits `(proof, publicValues)` to the precompile, which verifies         the proof, marks the input nullifiers spent, and returns the proven         `(recipient, amount)`; the vault then mints `amount` of its token to `recipient`.
